entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
On The 13 th Of September, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 38208 of 2024
 Kanhaiyalal @ Kanhai Raikwar
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Amit Goswami - Advocate for applicant.
 Shri Samar Ghuraiya - Public Prosecutor for the State.

Order 
This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of bail relating to Crime No.61/2015 registered at Police Station Nateran District Vidisha (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 366-A, 376(2), 506 of IPC and Section 6 of POCSO Act and Section 3(1)(12) of SC/ST Act.
This is a case of bail jump.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that earlier the applicant was granted bail vide order dated 27.07.2015 passed in M.Cr.C. No.6919 of 2015, however, during the course of trial, he remained absent on 18.08.2021, therefore, arrest warrant was issued against him and thereafter perpetual warrant was issued against him and in compliance of which he got arrested on 21.07.2024 and since then he is in custody.
It is further argued that on account of COVID -19 pandemic and thereafter as the applicant was not aware about the proceedings of the case, he could not appear before the court below.
It is further submitted that applicant is in custody since 21.07.2024.
His further custodial interrogation is not required.
He is ready and willing to abide by all the terms and conditions which may be imposed NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:15809 2 MCRC-38208-2024 by this Court upon him.
The trial will take time to conclude.

On these grounds,
he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
In case, if he/she is found involving in the offence of same nature, this bail order shall stand cancelled automatically without further reference to the Bench.

5) The applicant will not seek unnecessary adjournments during the trial; and NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:15809 3 MCRC-38208-2024 6) The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be.
The Trial Judge will be at liberty to forfeit the amount of earlier bail bonds.
It is made clear that in case of bail jump, this order shall automatically stand cancelled.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
Certified copy as per rules.

(RAJENDRA KUMAR VANI) JUDGE Aman Kanhaiyalal @ Kanhai Raikwar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95166957/
